facts.fact: Raxio Group's CIV1, a carrier-neutral colocation data centre at Grand Bassam (VITIB), opened in 2024 and sells colocation and cross-connects to customers.
Raxio says CIV1 is Uptime Institute Tier III certified (2,000 m2 white space, 400 racks, 3 MW IT power); the page gives no certification date, so the date is the page's published date.
